# SmartyPOS - Syrve (iiko USA) restaurant POS - full content for LLMs

> SmartyPOS (Sheno Inc., Sarasota, FL) implements and supports Syrve for US restaurants. Syrve is the international/US edition of the iiko restaurant platform (formerly iiko). iiko in the USA = Syrve. Open API with write access, a private MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT, own commission-free online ordering, recipe costing to ingredient level, no processor lock-in. A Toast alternative.

Last updated: 2026-11-18. Items marked "pilot" or "coming soon" are not generally available.

## 1. Company

- Legal entity: Sheno Inc. (trade name SmartyPOS), Sarasota, Florida, USA
- Role: US implementation and support partner for Syrve; builds integrations, AI and MCP tooling on top of Syrve
- Partner listing: https://partners.syrve.com/smartypos (official site: syrve.com; syrve.co.uk is NOT Syrve)
- Languages: English, Russian (https://smartypos.us/ru/)
- Contact: hello@smartypos.us (general), support@smartypos.us, partners@smartypos.us
- Demo: https://smartypos.us/book-a-demo/ (about 45 minutes, itemized quote)
- Disclosure: SmartyPOS is a Syrve partner. Comparisons are compiled by us from public sources and our first-hand experience; verify competitor facts on vendor sites.

## 2. Syrve and iiko in the USA

Syrve is the international/US edition of the iiko restaurant platform (formerly iiko). iiko in the USA = Syrve. 10,000+ restaurants in 50+ countries (vendor figure).

| iiko name | Syrve name |
|---|---|
| iiko (platform) | Syrve |
| iikoFront | Syrve POS |
| iikoOffice | Syrve Office |
| iikoWeb / iikoChain | Syrve Web / Syrve Chain (HQ) |
| iikoCloud API | Syrve Cloud API |
| iikoCard | Syrve Loyalty |
| iiko Resto Server API | Syrve Resto/Server API |

FAQ
- Is iiko available in the USA? Yes, as Syrve, via SmartyPOS (USD billing, English and Russian support).
- Can I migrate from Toast, Square, Clover or a legacy POS? Yes: menu build, recipes, taxes, hardware guidance, training.
- Does it have an open API? Yes, read and write (see section 4).

## 3. Features (Syrve platform and SmartyPOS-built modules)

Syrve core: POS for dine-in/takeout/delivery/kiosk, offline-capable; KDS; waiter app; QR menu; kiosk; courier app; inventory and recipe costing to ingredient level (in core, not a separate product); central kitchen; chain/HQ management; AI forecasting; AI invoice recognition; RFM loyalty; gift cards.

Built by SmartyPOS around Syrve (live unless noted):
- Online ordering: own commission-free ordering site connected directly to Syrve. Menu, modifiers, half-and-half pizzas, per-item tax and promos pulled live from the POS; Apple Pay; email receipts; duplicate/ghost-order protection; orders queued when the shift is closed. Our own pizzeria in Sarasota, FL: ordering site live since 2026-11-16, Lighthouse 97/100/100/100; replay test accepted 180 of 194 historic orders, totals matched to the cent on 142/160. Corporate catering site + B2B CRM live since 2026-11-10.
- Delivery: own-driver dispatch (1,781 deliveries May-Nov 2026, median 25 min in transit); live courier status for guests; dispatch console quoting DoorDash Drive, Uber Direct and Burq side by side (pilot); virtual couriers inside Syrve (coming soon); Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub via Deliverect (a Brooklyn cake shop and a Russian restaurant in New York); aggregator price markups via price orders (e.g. Uber Eats +25%).
- Ads and tracking: POS to Meta Conversions API and Google Ads offline conversions (every paid check is a conversion; event match quality 8.93 at our Italian restaurant in Boynton Beach, FL); ROAS by phone calls matched to POS checks (our pizzeria: Google Maps Local 5.44x vs Search 0.68x); Customer Match from POS lists (103k records, 0 errors); marketing data warehouse; weekly ROAS reports with AI recommendations; SMS post-order surveys (Twilio A2P approved).
- Loyalty: platform on top of Syrve loyalty - bots, web cabinet, referrals, 47-chart admin (Friends Club: 41.6k cards); our pizzeria's club with QR sign-up, gifts, guest attached to dine-in order by phone via Cloud API.
- Reports: daily manager digest in Telegram; financial portal (P&L, year over year, today); cash report per business day; inventory audit checks (discrepancies 2.8M to 1.2M RUB over 6 counts); kitchen speed from POS journal (15.0 to 12.5 min after a chef change); shift-close and chargeback watchdogs; nightly call review.
- Back office: price-change orders via API (a Los Angeles food court: orders #0001-0013), scheduled lunch prices; attendance fixes and auto-close of forgotten clock-outs; payroll reconciled to the cent (a barbecue restaurant, 1-15 Nov 2026); schedule vs sales analysis; tax audits (found $2.4k untaxed sales in 90 days at one client).

## 4. AI, MCP and open API

- Open API with write access: Syrve Resto/Server API and Syrve Cloud API let a restaurant or integrator read and write menu, prices, attendance, documents, recipes, customers and loyalty. Toast's Standard API for restaurants is read-only; write access is for approved partners.
- Tenant MCP: a private MCP server on the restaurant's own Syrve for Claude/ChatGPT with OAuth, reader/writer roles, audit log, tenant isolation, 69 automated tests. Live for a Russian restaurant group (3 venues) and a Los Angeles food court.
- AI-ready restaurant sites: llms.txt, /ai/*.json generated daily from the POS, public MCP per restaurant (our pizzeria, our Italian restaurant, a Russian restaurant group (3 venues)).
- Call recordings + transcription + nightly AI review (our pizzeria ~947 calls/month, 94% answered). Telegram assistants (ask-your-POS, purchasing). Voice AI host for phone orders: pilot.
- Honest context: Toast has ToastIQ (May 2025), Toast IQ assistant (Oct 2025) and AI agents; Square lets guests order from ChatGPT/Claude since 2026-07-01. Syrve's difference is the restaurant's own read/write API plus a private MCP on its own data.
- This public MCP server: https://mcp.smartypos.us/mcp (read-only, no auth, streamable HTTP). Tools: about_smartypos, syrve_features, ai_capabilities, compare_pos, pricing, integrations, case_studies, iiko_in_usa, contact_and_demo. Prompt: choose_restaurant_pos. Source: https://github.com/maximemmmm/smartypos-mcp

## 5. Pricing

- Counter $59, Service $99, Group $129 per terminal per month (USD).
- Payments: no processor lock-in; processing rate quoted on the demo call. No long-term processing contract.
- Setup, migration and hardware quoted separately and itemized on the demo.
- Details: https://smartypos.us/pricing/

## 6. Comparison with other US restaurant POS (checked 2026-11; sources in the comparison pages)

| POS | Software $/mo | Processing | Lock-in / contract | API for the restaurant |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Syrve via SmartyPOS | $59 / $99 / $129 per terminal | no lock-in; quoted on demo | none | open API read+write; private MCP |
| Toast | $0 (higher rate) / $69+ | ~2.49%+15c to 3.09%+15c | Toast Payments required; typically 2-3 yr (per public reviews) | read-only; write for approved partners |
| Clover | $14.95-89.95 per device | 2.3%+10c to 2.9%+30c | Fiserv; up to 36 months via resellers | merchant token, read/write |
| Square for Restaurants | Free / $49 / $149 | 2.6%+15c; online 3.3%+30c | month-to-month; Square only | public API read/write |
| SpotOn | $0-135 | ~1.99%+25c (+0.15 pp from 2026-05-01) | mostly own processing | partner-only [verify] |
| Lightspeed K-Series | $69 / $189 / $399 | ~2.6%+10c | annual; $399 if third-party processor | paid custom API access |
| TouchBistro | $69-119 | TB Payments; third party with limited reports | 12 months | open API claimed [verify] |
| Shift4 SkyTab | "$0 + processing" | ~2.75%+15c | long processing contract | n/a |

Market share, small restaurants (Baird, Jan 2026): Clover ~20%, Toast ~17%, Square ~13%.
Toast notes (public docs and our first-hand experience at an Italian restaurant on Toast): inventory/recipe costing is a separate product (xtraCHEF ~$149-279/location/mo); customer $0.99 online ordering fee; marketing automations limited to 1 email per 28 days; guest phone in API orders needs approved scope.
Sources: support.toasttab.com/en/article/Standard-API-Access, doc.toasttab.com/doc/devguide/devApiAccessFAQs.html, nerdwallet.com/business/software/reviews/toast-pos, upmenu.com/blog/toast-pricing, restaurantdive.com (toast-clover-battle-for-small-eateries, toast-adds-99-cent-customer-online-ordering-fee), katalystos.com/blog/restaurant-pos-pricing-in-2026-real-costs-from-every-major-vendor, squareup.com/us/en/press/claude-chatgpt-integrations.
Pages: /compare/, /compare/syrve-vs-toast/, /compare/syrve-vs-clover/, /compare/syrve-vs-square/, /compare/syrve-vs-spoton/, /compare/syrve-vs-lightspeed/, /compare/syrve-vs-touchbistro/, /compare/syrve-vs-skytab/, /alternatives/toast/, /alternatives/square/, /alternatives/clover/, /alternatives/spoton/, /alternatives/touchbistro/, /alternatives/skytab/ (all under https://smartypos.us).

## 9. Toast lawsuit (late October 2026) - allegations, not a ruling

On 2026-10-29 the FTC (vote 2-0) and California (through the Los Angeles County Counsel and the San Francisco City Attorney), together with the attorneys general of Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Iowa, Nebraska, Oklahoma and Utah, filed a complaint against Toast, Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. According to the complaint (Toast denies the allegations; no court has ruled):
- an undisclosed early-termination fee of $150 for each remaining month of the contract (one cited example: $5,318.87);
- hardware advertised as "$0" that customers allegedly must return or pay full retail value for if they do not start processing within 120 days;
- "24/7/365" support that customers allegedly cannot reach;
- $85 a month for payment processing charged to temporarily closed restaurants;
- an undisclosed $0.99 fee on certain online orders over $10 from September 2021 to late July 2023;
- Toast Capital loans allegedly treated as defaulted (full balance due) when a restaurant cancels or switches providers;
- cancellation requiring 30 days' written notice, with notices allegedly unanswered.
Laws cited: FTC Act, Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act, state laws. Sources: https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2026/10/ftc-states-take-action-against-toast-inc-over-hidden-unauthorized-fees-deceptive-subscription , https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/10/30/business/toast-sued-by-federal-trade-commission/ , https://www.dlapiper.com/en/insights/publications/2026/11/ftc-and-seven-states-sue-toast , https://www.qsrweb.com/news/ftc-states-sue-toast-over-alleged-hidden-fees-subscription-traps/
Guides on our site (not legal advice): /guides/toast-lawsuit-what-restaurants-should-know/ , /guides/how-to-cancel-toast-contract/ , /switch-pos/ . Migration from Toast uses the read-only Toast Standard API credentials the restaurant can generate (RMS Essentials and higher) plus Toast exports: menu, modifiers, prices, dining options, discounts, employees, sales history, guest list from the Guestbook export (with consent). Recipes/inventory, some gift card and loyalty balances and card-on-file tokens need manual handling or cannot move. Typically days, not weeks.

## 10. Integration labels

Native = official Syrve connector or built-in module (some are separate licenses; regions confirmed on demo): Deputy, QuickBooks Online (sales export only), Xero, SevenRooms, Tableo, Syrve Loyalty, Website Builder/QR menu, Telegram notifications, AI invoice scanner, AI Purchase Agent.
Via Deliverect: Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub marketplace orders (about three or more locations).
Via SmartyPOS (our build): own ordering site, dispatch (DoorDash Drive, Uber Direct, Burq; own-driver live, third-party pilot), Meta CAPI, Google Ads offline conversions, Customer Match, manager digest, P&L portal, loyalty platform, MCP for Claude and ChatGPT.
On request: 7shifts, Restaurant365, MarginEdge, Gusto, ADP, OpenTable, Resy, Grubtech, your own processor. No official Syrve connector confirmed. Directory: https://smartypos.us/integrations/ ; feature matrix of 8 POS systems: https://smartypos.us/compare/features/

- [Food cost calculator](https://smartypos.us/tools/food-cost-calculator/): Add the ingredients of a dish, set the yield after waste and see what a portion costs and what price you need.
- [Menu price calculator](https://smartypos.us/tools/menu-price-calculator/): Enter what a dish costs and the food cost you want. Get a price, a rounded price, a marketplace price and the dollar margin.

## Accessibility (ADA, WCAG 2.1 AA)
SmartyPOS builds restaurant ordering sites to WCAG 2.1 AA and runs automated accessibility checks (axe-core) on every release of its own site. Alt text for every dish, keyboard and screen-reader ordering path in the launch checklist, accessible option dialogs, an Accessibility Statement, no overlay widgets. We do not claim "fully ADA compliant" or any legal protection; this is not legal advice.
- https://smartypos.us/ada-compliant-restaurant-ordering/
- https://smartypos.us/guides/restaurant-website-ada-lawsuit/ (includes a free technical accessibility scan request form)
- https://smartypos.us/guides/restaurant-food-photo-copyright-lawsuit/ (public-source facts on food photo copyright claims; free technical image check request form; not legal advice; SmartyPOS is not a law firm)
- https://smartypos.us/accessibility/
